name: meanrev-stocks-v1
description: First rigorous nested/purged protocol run for the live meanrev_stocks sleeve (Connors RSI2+SMA200 daily). Universe: MEANREV_UNIVERSE copied verbatim from src/strategies/meanrev/MeanRevEngine.ts:226 (32 symbols, disjoint from momentum_stocks by design — shared Alpaca wallet); refSymbol SPY is benchmark/timeline only and is NOT traded. Incumbent candidate = production DEFAULT_MEANREV_CONFIG (entryRsi 5, smaLong 200, smaExit 5, timeStop 10, 5 slots x 10%) plus 3 moderate alternates, all counted in trial accounting. priorUniqueTrials=9 is the documentable LOWER BOUND of prior meanrev hypotheses (incumbent replay in backtest-meanrev.ts; 2 sizing variants in backtest-meanrev-wide.ts; MR-short; crypto-1h MR; slotPct sweep 0.10/0.20/0.30/0.40 per AUDITS 2026-07-27) — inventory incomplete, so complete=false and approval stays blocked by protocol. asOf=latest because HON daily bars end 2026-07-10 while the rest of the universe reaches 2026-07-31. Acceptance uses minExcessSharpeVsBench (NOT minExcessReturnVsBench): the sleeve deploys at most ~50% notional on dip days, so the fair benchmark-relative vara is risk-adjusted (see AcceptanceConfig in scripts/walk-forward.ts).
